item.title: Lebanon’s displaced families struggle to rebuild daily life
item.summary: Fleeing under bombardment, leaving home after nightfall – this has become the reality for many families in Lebanon. Far from their homes, they are now trying to recreate a semblance of daily life. Our correspondent in Beirut went to meet families displaced by the conflict.

item.title: ‘We cut down the menu’: Cooking gas crisis hits restaurants in India amid war in Iran
item.summary: Restaurants in India are suffering the consequences of disruptions to supplies of cooking gas caused by the war in the Middle East. Two restaurant owners describe the mounting challenges of operating under the crisis and the measures they’re taking to adapt.

item.title: Zelensky in Paris: Macron vows to keep support for Ukraine
item.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron Friday vowed to keep up pressure on Russia to end its four-year invasion of Ukraine after Washington partially rolled back sanctions against Moscow to cool oil prices sent soaring by the Middle East war. FRANCE 24's Camille Knight reports.
